Mitchell (CLE) briefly has a hand placed against Knueppel's (CHA) body, which he removes without affecting Knueppel's shot attempt.

Knueppel (CHA) legally contests Mitchell's (CLE) jump shot attempt.

Ball (CHA) commits a take foul on Mitchell (CLE).
Kalkbrenner (CHA) firms up on his right foot in Mitchell's (CLE) path and does not deliver contact.
Allen (CLE) legally contests Miller's (CHA) jump shot attempt.
Knueppel (CHA) commits a take foul on Mitchell (CLE).
